name: opfs-async
description: Monorepo for opfs-lsm, a browser key-value store on OPFS and IndexedDB
author: Guido D'Orsi

scripts.static: pnpm lint && pnpm check:docs && pnpm deadcode
scripts.test: node scripts/check-readme.mjs && pnpm --filter './packages/*' run build && pnpm run '/^test:(suites|examples)$/'
scripts.test:suites: pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/kv test:unit && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/docstore test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/yjs test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/automerge test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/tanstack-db test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/fate test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/bench test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/example-whiteboard-yjs test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/example-notes-manager-automerge test
scripts.test:docstore: pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/docstore test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/yjs test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/automerge test
